title: Curology Prescription Days Supply Leaderboard
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=curology:prescription bottle_days_supply=*
| stats sum(bottle_days_supply) as total_value, avg(bottle_days_supply) as avg_value by formula_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks formula values by total and average days supply across Curology prescription events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `bottle_days_supply` values for each Curology prescription event and review total and average days supply by formula.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total days supply.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which formula shows the biggest days supply numbers in your Curology prescription data.
